constraints.constraint: HEADER-ONLY CONFIGURATION: Every configurable value MUST be defined in a header file. No magic numbers in source code. Use defined constants: GPIO_*, TIMING_*, LIMIT_*, CMD_*, ERR_*, etc.
DUAL-CORE SEPARATION: safety_monitor_task runs on Core 0 at priority 24 (highest). Must not block or call Core 1 motion control directly. Use thread-safe interfaces.
ALWAYS STOP FIRST: When limit triggers, always stop motion first before evaluating direction. Eliminates velocity-check race conditions.
CONTROLLED DECELERATION: Never hard stop. Use controlled deceleration via stopAxis() to prevent mechanical damage.
BOTH-LIMITS FAULT: If MIN and MAX are both active simultaneously, enter FAULT state (likely wiring/sensor failure).
EVENT LATENCY: Limit event must be published within 10ms of switch activation.
